name: Snapchat Ads
label: Snap Marketing API v1 — campaigns, ads, stats, conversions
description: Official Snap Marketing API v1 at https://adsapi.snapchat.com/v1 plus CAPI v3 at https://tr.snapchat.com. Docs: https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/home · https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/Conversions-API/Parameters. Create ops take official campaigns/adsquads/ads/creatives arrays. conversion.upload takes data[] + test_event_code. Bearer access_token (CAPI also accepts query access_token). Never log tokens or user_data.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets (access_token) here. Example: {"operation":"campaign.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'organization.list' | 'campaign.create' | 'campaign.list' | 'adsquad.create' | 'adsquad.list' | 'ad.create' | 'ad.list' | 'creative.create' | 'stats.get' | 'conversion.upload'.

schema.label: ad_account_id
schema.description: Ad account UUID. Required for campaign/adsquad/ad/creative ops unless set in config.

schema.label: campaigns
schema.description: One campaign object escape hatch merged into campaigns[0]. Named purpose fields win.

schema.label: adsquads
schema.description: One adsquad object escape hatch merged into adsquads[0]. Named purpose fields win.

schema.label: ads
schema.description: One ad object escape hatch merged into ads[0]. Named purpose fields win.

schema.label: creatives
schema.description: One creative object escape hatch merged into creatives[0]. Named purpose fields win.

schema.label: entity_type
schema.description: stats.get path entity. EXACT: ads | adsquads | campaigns | adaccounts.

schema.label: entity_id
schema.description: stats.get entity UUID.

schema.label: granularity
schema.description: stats.get TOTAL | DAY | HOUR | LIFETIME as documented.

schema.label: start_time
schema.description: campaign.create start_time ISO-8601. Wired to campaigns[0].start_time. Also stats.get query.

schema.label: end_time
schema.description: stats.get ISO-8601 end.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: stats.get comma-separated metrics.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: List page size (cursor pagination).

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: List cursor from the previous page.

schema.label: with_ad_accounts
schema.description: organization.list query with_ad_accounts=true to include ad accounts.

schema.label: pixel_id
schema.description: CAPI v3 asset/pixel id for conversion.upload path /v3/{pixel_id}/events. Required.

schema.label: data
schema.description: CAPI v3 events array for conversion.upload (required). Each event: event_name (PURCHASE|PAGE_VIEW|…), event_time (epoch sec/ms), action_source (WEB|OFFLINE|MOBILE_APP), event_source_url, event_id, user_data (hashed em/ph, client_ip_address, client_user_agent), custom_data (currency, value). Hash identifiers; do not log. Example: [{"event_name":"PURCHASE","event_time":1705508777,"action_source":"WEB","user_data":{"em":["<sha256>"]}}].

schema.label: test_event_code
schema.description: Top-level CAPI v3 test_event_code for conversion.upload. Any string, e.g. datahash. Omit for production.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Create-op name. campaign.create → campaigns[0].name; adsquad.create → adsquads[0].name; ad.create → ads[0].name; creative.create → creatives[0].name.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Create-op status. EXACT ACTIVE | PAUSED. Wired to campaigns[0]/adsquads[0]/ads[0].status.

schema.label: objective
schema.description: campaign.create objective. Wired to campaigns[0].objective. EXACT AWARENESS | CONSIDERATION | CONVERSIONS | SALES.

schema.label: daily_budget_micro
schema.description: campaign.create / adsquad.create daily_budget_micro (micro-currency).

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: adsquad.create campaign_id. Wired to adsquads[0].campaign_id.

schema.label: type
schema.description: adsquad/ad/creative type. adsquads[0].type / ads[0].type / creatives[0].type (SNAP_AD | APP_INSTALL | …).

schema.label: bid_micro
schema.description: adsquad.create bid_micro. Wired to adsquads[0].bid_micro.

schema.label: ad_squad_id
schema.description: ad.create ad_squad_id. Wired to ads[0].ad_squad_id.

schema.label: creative_id
schema.description: ad.create creative_id. Wired to ads[0].creative_id.

schema.label: brand_name
schema.description: creative.create brand_name. Wired to creatives[0].brand_name.

schema.label: headline
schema.description: creative.create headline. Wired to creatives[0].headline.

schema.label: call_to_action
schema.description: creative.create call_to_action. Wired to creatives[0].call_to_action.

schema.label: top_snap_media_id
schema.description: creative.create top_snap_media_id. Wired to creatives[0].top_snap_media_id.

schema.label: shareable
schema.description: creative.create shareable. Wired to creatives[0].shareable.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. PII may be present — do not log bodies.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: organization.list | campaign.create | campaign.list | adsquad.create | adsquad.list | ad.create | ad.list | creative.create | stats.get | conversion.upload.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Snap OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Refresh outside this node (~60 minutes). Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Ad account id
configurationParameters.description: Default ad account UUID for campaign/adsquad/ad/creative paths when input.ad_account_id is blank.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 uses api_spec default. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
